name: Daniel Moya
title: Engineering an Autonomous Internal Platform Across Hybrid Metal and Cloud with Dimensigon
abstract: Internal Developer Platforms (IDPs) often face a hard reality: enterprise infrastructure is rarely pure Kubernetes. Legacy bare-metal instances, edge gateways, and multi-region clouds demand a flexible, technology-agnostic automation fabric that platform teams can trust. This talk presents the platform architecture behind Dimensigon (https://dimensigon.com). We explore how platform teams can provide self-service orchestration through visual drag-and-drop workflow builders, Git-like orchestration versioning, and granular role-based access control (RBAC). We demonstrate how Dimensigon's decentralized mesh eliminates fragile central bastions, how the distributed vault seamlessly injects secrets, and how integrated execution diff history provides audit-ready compliance across the entire hybrid server fleet.
bio: Independent software and AI architect building distributed data systems (HeliosDB), decentralized orchestration (Dimensigon), and AI-augmented applications.
